title: B3 Rolling-Window Systemic-Risk Data and Reproducibility Materials, 1995-2025
description: Data, validation outputs, network edge lists, figures, and reproducibility materials supporting the manuscript 'Taxonomy of Critical Phenomena in Financial Markets'. The package covers 360 monthly rolling windows of Brazilian B3 equity networks, four configured core stress events, one additional 1999 trigger, and six fallback sensitivity proxies. The study is retrospective and descriptive; the archive does not provide causal or predictive evidence.
notes: Dedicated code repository target: https://github.com/gersonncardoso/taxonomy-critical-phenomena-financial-markets. Replace this metadata with the DOI and landing-page URL generated by Zenodo after publication. Do not cite this pre-publication package as a persistent dataset record.
